children: US oil and gas producer's Q3 revenue rose 37% yr/yr on higher production and prices
Adjusted net income per share for Q3 rose to $0.64 from $0.42 last year
Company plans to continue one-rig development in the Cherokee Play and pursue M&A opportunities
HIGHER PRODUCTION - Co said Q3 production rose 10% yr/yr, driven by new wells from its Cherokee development program and recently acquired assets
HIGHER COMMODITY PRICES - Co said improved oil and NGL prices contributed to higher revenues in Q3
ASSET ACQUISITION - Co said recently acquired assets in the Cherokee Play contributed to increased production and revenue for part of Q3
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is no "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the oil & gas exploration and production peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for SandRidge Energy Inc is $14.00, about 4.6% above its November 3 closing price of $13.38
The stock recently traded at 8 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 8 three months ago
